title: Daisy Eye and Spirit Fox
description: A surreal scene features a giant white daisy with a detailed green feline eye at its center. A glowing white kitsune-like fox with multiple tails stands on a broken stone staircase beside it, surrounded by film strips, crumbling ruins, and dramatic light rays beaming from an opening above.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene with a giant white daisy flower whose center is a vivid green cat-like eye with a black slit pupil. A luminous white kitsune fox with multiple flowing tails stands on a broken stone staircase to the right. The environment is dark and ruined with crumbling stone steps, overgrown plants, and old film strips in orange and blue winding through the composition. Beams of bright cinematic light shine down from a circular opening at the top, creating god rays in a dark blue and black environment.
